speaker: Doctor
text: The ultrasound confirms multiple medullary cysts with preserved renal function and normal electrolytes, which is highly suggestive of a hereditary condition. Given your history of recurrent urinary tract infections and hematuria, do you have any family members who have been diagnosed with kidney cysts or have a history of kidney failure?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Hematuria and right flank pain. I also have History of recurrent urinary tract infections, No recent trauma.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Medullary Sponge Kidney (a form of hereditary nephrolithiasis characterized by ectatic medullary collecting ducts, predisposing to recurrent UTIs, hematuria, flank pain, and nephrolithiasis).
